title: Voice and Services Engineer - São Paulo/Rio de Janeiro Based
description: About the Team As a Network Engineering member in the Voice and Services functional area, you will be responsible to propose, analyse and define requirements for new and existing services and systems related to voice. You will prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes for the existing portfolio, define and support the technology evolution roadmap, and participate in cross‑functional projects. Responsibilities Collaborate with other Networks teams to define and manage projects for delivery of new solutions. Deliver projects, including network design, integration, migration strategy definition, and end‑to‑end delivery. Design new consumer and corporate telecom solutions. Create and maintain technical documentation (HLD, LLD, WO, etc.) throughout the solution lifecycle. Perform implementations in live environments and understand end‑to‑end system testing requirements. Follow up and define quality and performance indicators. Perform capacity and performance analysis, reporting, and solution improvement definitions. Define and implement service & resource configuration on requested systems. Work on complex solutions that influence current product design and address future product or technology issues. Maintain close relationships with external partners such as carriers and service providers. Manage change request processes with partners to meet network necessities. Control the network elements roadmap, responsible for required software/hardware upgrades during component lifecycle. Generate and implement process improvements, including cross‑team processes. Document existing technology portfolio and propose recommendations for improvements or alternatives. Requirements Must‑haves Proven experience implementing live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS) and in network design, capacity management, engineering, and architecture. Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications. Experience designing, testing, and operating NGN‑based networks, including MSS/MGW, HLR/HSS, SBC. Experience defining, establishing, and maintaining voice interconnects SIP/RTP‑based. Understanding of IMS architecture and knowledge of VoIP, VoLTE, VoWiFi, QoS. Experience with SMS service configuration and routing. Knowledge of IMS nodes (P/S/I‑CSCF, Application Servers) and IMS protocol interfaces (GM, ISC, SH, Cx, SOAP/XML, etc.). Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online) and knowledge of OCS and Ro, Ro+, Ga, and Bp interfaces. Knowledge of Diameter/SCTP networks and protocols. Knowledge of Signaling Gateways and protocols including SS7, SIGTRAN, MAP, CAMEL. Experience using protocol analyzer tools such as Wireshark, Astelia, to troubleshoot network errors or problems. Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions. Familiarity with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape. English proficiency mandatory; other languages are a plus. Degree in Telecom Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. Nice‑to‑haves +3 years of experience designing and implementing mobile core networks. Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle, and Ribbon IMS products. Benefits CLT contract – job stability and reliable benefits. Quarterly performance bonuses to reward hard work. Meal allowance paid into Caju card – R$100 per working day. Health insurance with SulAmérica – 50% covered by the company. Extended parental leave – 180 days maternity, 20 days paternity. Daycare allowance for mothers with children under 3 years old – R$500 per month per child. Why 1GLOBAL? Growth Opportunities – advance your career in a fast‑growing company. Major Transaction Exposure – impact future telco industry with significant transactions. Work with a Talented Team – collaborate with senior leaders and skilled advisors. Dynamic Work Environment – thrive in a fast‑paced, innovative workplace. Professional Development – enhance skills alongside industry experts. International Experience – opportunities to work across global offices. Open Communication Culture – ideas heard and dialogue encouraged. Get Things Done Attitude – results‑driven team values efficiency and creativity. 1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Legal Counsel Customs and Export Controls Governance (m/f/d)
description: OPEN TO APPLICANTS IN LATAM with experience in customs and export controls and legal background. Fresenius Medical Care is the world’s leading provider of products and services for individuals with renal diseases of which around 3.9 million patients worldwide regularly undergo dialysis treatment. We care for more than 344,000 dialysis patients and provide our products in around 150 countries. With a strong focus on innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, we have consistently achieved remarkable growth and established ourselves as a trusted brand in the dialysis market. Purpose and Scope As a Legal Counsel Customs and Export Controls Governance (m/f/d) , you will contribute to the legal backbone of Fresenius Medical Care’s global trade operations. In this role, you will provide legal guidance on customs and export control matters, support the development of compliant and cost-efficient supply chains, and help integrate trade governance into our global processes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure adherence to international trade laws and internal policies, while driving continuous improvement and automation in trade-related legal frameworks. This is an exciting opportunity to grow within a dynamic legal environment and make a meaningful impact on global healthcare logistics. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Provide legal advice, counsel and guidance and on a range of trade governance matters such as customs and export controls, free trade agreements, special customs regimes and related risk management issues. Ensure that FME and affiliates operate globally in accordance with applicable trade governance laws and regulations, as well as applicable and relevant internal policies. Support and advise on the development and optimization of supply chains and flows of goods to achieve cost optimization in accordance with global trade laws. Support the integration and automation of trade governance processes into FME’s global operations and processes from a legal perspective. Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of Global Standard Operating Procedures (GSOPs) for customs and export controls, providing legal guidance and review in collaboration with stakeholders. Continuous review of customs and export controls legislation and its applicability to FME business models and transactions. Legal support and guidance in customs broker engagement and performance reviews. Collaboration with stakeholders and the Customs and Export Controls Governance team for assessing training needs. Support global development and customization of trainings to FME professionals involved in trade-related activities. Support the coordination of global support for handling trade authorities’ audits, reviews and challenges. Support in the development for automation of trade-related processes and activities. Education Fully qualified lawyer, incl. above-average university degree. Experience and Required Skills 8+ years experience in customs and export controls in an international law firm and/or in-house legal department of an internationally operating and complex corporation, specializing in customs and export control matters. Preferred Master’s degree or equivalent. Experience in roll-out and implementation of customs and export control policies, processes and trainings. Ideally, experience in the healthcare sector. Technical Skills Good knowledge of global trade, including customs, and export control laws and regulations. Knowledge of relevant commercial, tax and supply chain processes. Ability to understand and apply regulatory requirements to business operations. Experience with relevant trade compliance tools or willingness to learn. Excellent written and spoken English, additional languages highly welcome. Soft Skills Innovation Mindset: embrace use of technology, automation and data analytics. Ability to work autonomously and to remotely. Ability to interpret complex customs and export control laws and regulations and apply them to real-world situations. Ability to deal with ambiguity, complexity and conflicting priorities, whilst keeping a focus on main drivers. Sound legal judgment under time pressure, balancing legal risk with business goals. Working closely with venue teams, technical suppliers, and the broader Entertainment department, the Stadium Entertainment Manager will act as the primary entertainment point of contact for their assigned venue(s), managing operational workflows, coordinating suppliers, and overseeing delivery timelines from a central coordination function. This role works in close collaboration with the on‑site venue entertainment teams, providing the planning structure, content, and operational direction required for seamless execution on match days. The Stadium Entertainment Manager is an office‑based coordination role suited to an experienced live events professional with strong project management skills, who can drive high‑quality entertainment delivery across multiple venues through effective planning, clear communication, and proactive stakeholder management. Key Responsibilities Stadium Entertainment Delivery Manage the day‑to‑day planning and delivery of all entertainment activations at assigned venue(s). Execute the FIFA‑approved Entertainment Concept at venue level, maintaining quality and consistency throughout the tournament. Coordinate all entertainment elements on match days, including pre‑match shows, half‑time activations, music programming and AV content. Act as the primary on‑site entertainment point of contact for venue management, technical crews, and Functional Area partners. Team Support Support the Stadium Entertainment Team by contributing to day‑to‑day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards across all entertainment activities. Assist with the onboarding and support of Stadium Entertainment personnel—including full‑time staff, freelancers, and event‑time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness. Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing within the entertainment workstream. Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units involved in stadium entertainment delivery. Contribute to coordination between venue‑based entertainment teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution across all stadiums. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Ceremonies Team to ensure unified delivery across entertainment and ceremonial workstreams. Technical & Production Coordination Liaise with technical suppliers including AV, LED, sound, and lighting providers to ensure correct installation and operation of all entertainment infrastructure. Support pre‑event technical surveys, production walkthroughs, and infrastructure assessments at assigned venues. Coordinate rehearsals and technical run‑throughs, ensuring all entertainment elements are tested and validated before match day. Manage show rundowns, cue sheets, and entertainment schedules for each match at assigned venue(s). Venue Readiness & Execution Support the preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), stadium production schedules, and PMC rundowns for Stadium Entertainment. Assist in preproduction processes, including coordinating technical surveys, gathering stadium LED screen specs, AV infrastructure reviews, and supplier installation planning. Contribute to readiness activities and provide on‑site support during live operations to ensure delivery standards are met. Support problem solving during matchday entertainment, escalating issues to the Senior Manager as needed. Coordinate rehearsal planning, scheduling, documentation, and stakeholder communication in alignment with Senior Manager guidance. Support the validation of entertainment elements during pre‑event testing and rehearsal phases. Assist with venue‑level pre‑production tasks, including gathering technical information, supporting infrastructure assessments, and coordinating installation planning. Content Production & Management Coordinate the receipt, testing, and deployment of all entertainment content at venue level, including music, video, graphics, and scripts. Ensure that all content is approved, correctly formatted, and delivered on time in line with operational deadlines. Maintain accurate records of content usage and ensure IP/copyright compliance at venue level. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Prepare match‑day reports, schedules, show notes and post‑event summaries for the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager. Maintain up‑to‑date operational documentation including rundowns, contact lists, and venue entertainment plans. Participate in regular team meetings, briefings, and review sessions. Flag operational risks and elevate issues to the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager in a timely manner. Supplier & Budget Management Support procurement processes as directed by the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager, including supplier briefing and evaluation. Manage day‑to‑day relationships with entertainment suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s). Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost‑tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow‑up. Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalating risks to the Senior Manager as needed. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Coordinate with Venue Operations, Broadcast, Protocol, Safety, and other Functional Areas and stakeholders to integrate entertainment seamlessly into match‑day operations. Support early‑phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by line management aligned with project delivery. Support the Head of Entertainment and Senior Stadium Entertainment Manager in planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration. Support cross‑venue entertainment activities and cover other venues as required during the tournament. Your Profile Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 5+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large‑scale public events. Demonstrated experience delivering in‑venue or stadium entertainment programmes, including AV, music and audience engagement activations. Experience working within large‑scale multi‑venue events or major international sporting events is highly desirable. Track record of coordinating multiple suppliers and technical teams in high‑pressure, time‑critical environments. Experience working with broadcast operations and an understanding of live TV production constraints is an advantage. Skills & Competencies Administrative skills: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. Adaptability: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high‑pressure environments. Flexibility: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. Communication skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. Organizational skills: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. Problem‑solving skills: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. Cross‑functional collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. Interpersonal skills: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment. Cultural sensitivity: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. Passion for entertainment: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience with Monday.com an advantage. title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
description: Senior Manager, Ceremonies Department: Events & Entertainment Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC27”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations. Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters. Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy. Team Leadership Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures. Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness. Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback. Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams. Major Ceremonies Oversight Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony. Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way. Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies. Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines. Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements. Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled. Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting. Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts. Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings. Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams. Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision-maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. Direct venue-level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning. Supplier & Budget Management Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning. Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation. Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing. Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements. Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes. Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE. Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders. Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies. Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Venue Readiness & Execution Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns. Direct venue level preproduction processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination. Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre event testing and rehearsal phases. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior managership aligned with project delivery. Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and senior managership briefings. Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 7+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events. Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations. Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination. Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets. Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies. Skills & Competencies ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including, RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments. FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. PROBLEM‑SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience of Monday.com an advantage. Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus The right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Mecânico Diesel
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR). No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Sua missão: Elaborar planos e executar manutenções. Substituir peças, reparar e testar desempenho de componentes e sistema de veículos. Efetuar diagnósticos e reparos em conjuntos mecânicos, pneumáticos, hidráulicos e elétricos. Realizar serviços de lubrificação dos veículos. Requisitos: Ensino Médio Completo. Experiência na função. Informática Básica. Atuação em concessionária e formação em técnica em Mecânica Diesel, Mecatrônica e afins, será um diferencial. Assistência Odontológica-cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família. Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral-proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio‑level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project‑level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward‑looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad‑hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio‑level, strategic mindset. Self‑motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment. Compensation Reasonable estimate of the current range: $76,400 CAD - $114,600 CAD. This role is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, health insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, and paid time off for sick leave and vacation, among other benefits. title: Analista de Planejamento e Análise Financeira (FP&A)
description: Analista de Planejamento e Análise Financeira (FP&A) 1 posição Não informado Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais 20 pontos do país, atendendo a 06 estados diferentes, sendo Equipo - RJ, Itaipu - MG, Itaipu Norte - PA, Quinta Roda - SP e Supermac - AM e RR. No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos e produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. title: GIG- Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais (Limpeza)
description: Descrição da vaga Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes. O Auxiliar de Limpeza realizará a limpeza interna das aeronaves para eliminar os riscos de contaminações por resíduos a bordo e proporcionar uma experiência satisfatória e agradável ao cliente de acordo com os procedimentos publicados no POPs – Procedimento Operacional Padronizado de Limpeza em vigor e das empresas aéreas clientes. Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto do Galeão (GIG) ! Responsabilidades e atribuições Realizar a limpeza e desinfecção dos ambientes internos de uma aeronave (galley, cabine, poltronas e toaletes) seguindo as normas, tempos e procedimentos contidos no MGO, no PLD (Plano de Limpeza e Desinfecção), publicados e regidos segundo as normas da ANVISA (Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária), recolher o lixo de bordo e realizar o descarte conforme indicações; Realizar a preparação dos kits de materiais de limpeza e de conforto que serão utilizados nos atendimentos à aeronaves, considerando o tipo de voo (pernoite/perdia, turnaround ou trânsito), as exigências locais da ANVISA (quando houver) e o giro de estoque da base. Realizar a reposição dos materiais de conforto e higiene, tais como revistas, materiais de toalete e sacos de lixo para serem utilizados pelos passageiros e pela tripulação durante o voo; Abastecer a bolsa com o material que será usado no atendimento; Atualizar as etiquetas do produto usado nos pulverizadores; Registrar no formulário objetos encontrados a bordo, esquecidos pelos passageiros; Entregar ao funcionário cliente os objetos encontrados a bordo e solicitar assinatura no formulário dnata; Realizar a limpeza de forma cuidadosa e eficiente, dentro do prazo estipulado pelo cliente aéreo; Separar os contentores de lixo comum e infectante separados, antes, durante e depois do atendimento. Requisitos e qualificações Organização e Planejamento; Trabalho em Equipe; Controle de Qualidade; Flexibilidade e Adaptabilidade; Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto para o atendimento do voo, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico para limpeza e deslocamento da escada da aeronave. Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para inspeções e limpezas e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais. Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais. Informações adicionais Estamos sempre em busca de novos talentos, então faça o seu cadastro e venha fazer parte do time dnata Brasil! #J-18808-Ljbffr

Garantir robustez e clareza nas recomendações de engenharia de reservatórios, incluindo comunicação transparente de incertezas, premissas e sensibilidades. description: Software Engineer, Brazil - X Delivery – BCG X Software Engineer, Brazil - X Delivery – BCG X Locations: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation‑inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom‑line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading‑edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. We Are BCG X We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game‑changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions. What You’ll Do As a part of BCG’s X Delivery team, you will play a pivotal role in bridging technology and strategy. You will collaborate with premier consulting teams around the world, applying your software development expertise across a variety of ambitious and ground‑breaking international projects. You will be instrumental in advancing BCG’s Consulting and BCG X teams by providing critical software development insights and speeding up project execution. As a Software Engineer, your role involves close collaboration with consulting teams to address complex and diverse technological challenges. You will apply your expertise in software development methodologies to add value to BCG’s Consulting & BCG X teams and Practice Areas. Each project offers a unique opportunity to showcase your skills and make a significant impact within BCG and our esteemed clientele. What You’ll Bring We are seeking technologically adept engineers who bring strong experience and diverse skills to our dynamic team. This role is an outstanding opportunity for someone who is passionate about software development and embraces opportunities to learn and make an impact in a fast‑paced, innovative environment. If you’re driven by technology and ready for impactful challenges, our BCG X Delivery team could be a great match! Technical Skills – Knowledge and Experience With Coding Skills: Strong coding skills and proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, Kotlin, Node.js, Go, Ruby, Rust, C#, etc. Experience with multiple languages preferred. Web Development Expertise: Experience with Typescript or JavaScript frameworks such as React, Next.js, and Angular. Demonstrated projects or work experience are helpful. API Development: Solid experience in creating APIs using REST or GraphQL. Cloud Computing: Familiar with AWS, Azure, GCP, and capable of effective deployment on these platforms. Database Management: Skilled in both relational and NoSQL databases, including MongoDB, Neo4j, and Redis. Additional Skills Experience with Spark, Hadoop, or similar systems. Practical knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, or similar technologies. Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI, Jenkins, etc. Tech curiosity with interest and exposure to technologies like AR/VR, IoT, AI, Blockchain. Knowledge of infrastructure as code practices using Terraform, Chef, Puppet, or Ansible. Job Requirements Bachelor’s / Master’s in Computer Science or a related field Fluency in Portuguese and English Proven background in end‑to‑end application development, preferably in a commercial or consulting environment. Active contributions to open‑source projects or technical communities are highly valued. Core Attributes Software Development: Demonstrated experience in developing, testing, and deploying robust software. Examples of past projects or contributions are advantageous. Full Lifecycle Experience: Active involvement in the complete software development lifecycle, showcasing skills from idea generation to deployment. Efficiency Optimization: Experience in optimizing software for performance and efficiency. Dynamic Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, client‑facing environment. Experience in client interactions for product development is a plus. Collaborative Skills: A track record of working effectively in team settings, sharing ideas, and co‑developing solutions. Additional Information Please apply for the positions equivalent to your previous work experiences. The seniority will be evaluated according to your experience and career structure at BCG X during the process. Even if you don’t meet all these requirements, we encourage you to apply if this job description excites you. Note: For this position, we are considering applicants from São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, including both the capital cities and the surrounding areas within a 150km radius of the capitals. Founded in 1867, and located in Washington, DC, in our nation’s capital, Howard University is a historically Black College/University and Research 1 (R1) institution with a distinguished legacy of advancing knowledge, leadership, and service in pursuit of social justice and equity. Serving 400 students, the Howard University School of Social Work offers two MSW concentrations: Direct Practice and Community, Administration, and Policy Practice. These concentrations are delivered through two program platforms, on-campus (Flagship) and online (Starship). The School offers specializations in criminal justice, health, mental health, family and child welfare, displaced populations, and social gerontology. We also offer three dual degree programs: MSW/MPH, MSW/MDiv, and MSW/MBA. Additionally, the School offers a Ph.D. in Social Work with specialized areas of scholarly inquiry. Grounded in the University’s enduring motto, Truth and Service, the HUSSW prepares scholars and practitioners committed to improving human well-being and addressing the structural conditions that affect marginalized communities. The School’s guiding philosophy, Black Perspective, further shapes its intellectual and practice framework through our curriculum and faculty scholarship that examine social and economic injustice, social determinants of health, behavioral health, poverty, and disparities effecting quality of life, particularly for African Americans and other historically oppressed populations. Our School has been continuously accredited during its 90-year history. We are a highly ranked graduate/professional program at the university having been ranked by the U.S. News and World Report among the country’s top-20 MSW programs. With an abiding interest in both domestic and international affairs, the University is committed to continuing to produce leaders for America and the global community. Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. title: Well Site Coordinator
description: The Well Site Supervisor is responsible to plan, coordinate, supervise, and execute the well operations program. They provide clear leadership in every aspect of HSE protection, ensuring safe working practices are used at the well site. They further ensure that well operations are conducted safely, in accordance with the approved well operations program, and in compliance with the applicable policies/standards/procedures and the regulatory requirements within allocated time/costs with optimal use of resources. Organize and lead brief and debrief safety and operations meetings that are related to well operations. Lead daily planning meetings and discuss operations with customer representatives, contractors, PL, and third-party supervisors. Update forecast and planned activity to anticipate resource requirements meet well demands and provide optimum service efficiency. Check that equipment and services comply with the contract. Manage proper inventory of tangibles such as, but not limited to, cement, barite, bits, as well as rental equipment, and coordinate with PL OP and third-party suppliers as needed. Ensure that operations are conducted to prevent risks of well control, stuck pipe, and any other project and operational risks. Monitor well operational risks, implement risk responses, and execute change control per the project risk management plan and well operational programs. Ensure compliance with Schlumberger policies and Integration PL standards, including standing orders. Prepare detailed procedures for specific critical operations (running casing, cementing, etc.) and associated contingency plans. Prepare daily cost estimates based on goods consumed and services provided. Review and approve invoices and reports on services performed and materials used. Manage and monitor operations communications with the goal of ensuring that stakeholders are kept informed and service providers are lacking any information that they need to perform their services. Prepare technical and operational calculations relevant to the well‑or rig‑site operations (e.g., cement volume). Participate in operational performance improvements and program changes with the project team. Review operational problems and support job incidents, changes, incident response and recovery, including coordination with the individual PLs and key contractors. Minimum Requirements Degree: Bachelor Degree complete Main experiences: Experience in supervising directional drilling operations (mandatory) Knowledge in fluids operations/engineering (desirable) Language: Advanced English and Portuguese Valid documentation to work in Brazil #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Professor(a) de Música (Music IB) - Ensino Médio - Urca/RJ
description: O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 126 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio. Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 28 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador. Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 14.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo. SOBRE A VAGA A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos. Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo. RESPONSABILIDADES O que você fará Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona; Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência; Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos; Ministrar aulas de Música (Music IB) alinhadas com o currículo IB, com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital); Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos; Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado; Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares; Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado; Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola; Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados; Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado; Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias; Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola; Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding). Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo. REQUISITOS O que você precisa ter Diploma de Licenciatura em Música; Experiência com Ensino Médio; Inglês fluente para ministrar as aulas nesse idioma. Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe; Paixão pela profissão; Adaptar seu estilo de ensino incorporando feedbacks; Estar sempre em busca de melhorias; Atitude positiva frente a mudanças; Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada; Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas; Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala; Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado; Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho; Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos. Será um diferencial se você tiver Experiência prévia com o currículo IB; Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais; Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time; Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída. DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem‑estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem‑estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação. Visit our careers site for more information; #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Product Training Consultant - Border Management
description: At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. We are present in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. We deliver fresh solutions and cutting‑edge technology to keep operations running like clockwork. We are recognized as a Great Place to Work by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Overview As a Product Training Consultant – Border Management you will support the delivery of high‑impact learning solutions across SITA’s airport, airline and border management technologies. This role focuses on programmes across Latin America, delivering training in Spanish, Portuguese and English. You will primarily work with existing global training materials—customising, localising and validating content—while delivering engaging training sessions aligned with operational and customer needs. Please submit your resume in English. What You Will Do Deliver training sessions (virtual and on‑site) to customers, partners and internal teams primarily across LATAM and other regions if required. Customise and localise existing training content to meet regional, language and customer requirements. Act as the quality gatekeeper for multilingual training content, including validation of machine‑translated materials. Collaborate with subject matter experts to confirm technical accuracy and relevance of training materials. Support updates to training materials based on product changes, feedback and operational needs. Define and maintain standards for training quality, consistency and terminology across languages. Ensure training content aligns with SITA standards, terminology and branding. Contribute to continuous improvement of training materials and delivery approaches. Leverage Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital tools to support training delivery. Gather feedback and support measurement of training effectiveness. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in education, learning technologies, languages or a related field (or equivalent experience). Experience delivering training in a professional or technical environment. Fluency in Spanish, Portuguese and English (written and spoken). Strong communication and presentation skills across multicultural audiences. Experience reviewing, editing or validating translated content (machine translation experience is a plus). Ability to understand and explain technical concepts clearly to different audiences. Experience working with LMS platforms or digital training tools is desirable. Strong attention to detail and quality when working with multilingual content. Good organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities. Willingness to travel across Latin America and other world locations as required. What We Offer Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days per week (depending on your team's needs). Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans. Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world. Employee Wellbeing: Employee Assistance Program (EAP) available 24/7, 365 days a year, and a personalised Champion Health platform. Professional Development: Training platform access including LinkedIn Learning. Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that fit local market and employment status. SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. Resiliência em Cenários Ambíguos: Conforto para atuar em ambientes de rápida mudança, transformando incertezas em planos de ação claros. Visão de Negócio e Estratégia: Entendimento de como o produto se encaixa nos objetivos macro da empresa e no mercado, garantindo que o roadmap esteja alinhado à sustentabilidade financeira e competitividade do negócio. title: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience
description: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing. We are looking for a Pricing & Payments Manager to lead the Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes function within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role owns the end-to-end strategy and execution of partner pricing models, incentive programs, payment accuracy, and dispute resolution across our Amazon Partner Logistics programs — EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large). As a People Manager, you will lead and develop a team of specialists, set the strategic direction for pricing and payment mechanisms, build scalable processes, and drive cross‑functional alignment with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to ensure partner economics are competitive, accurate, and sustainable. This position is based out of an Amazon corporate office and may require periodic travel. If you are passionate about partner economics, operational excellence, and building high‑performing teams, you should join our team. Key job responsibilities Lead, coach, and develop a team of Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes specialists, fostering a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement Own the end‑to‑end pricing strategy for logistics partners across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL programs, ensuring competitive and sustainable rate structures Design, implement, and optimize incentive programs that drive partner performance, network efficiency, and cost effectiveness Oversee the payment lifecycle — from invoice validation and payment accuracy to dispute identification, root‑cause analysis, and resolution Build and maintain scalable mechanisms for pricing governance, incentive tracking, payment reconciliation, and dispute management Develop structured reporting and dashboards to monitor pricing competitiveness, incentive ROI, payment accuracy, and dispute aging/resolution rates Partner cross‑functionally with Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to align pricing models with business objectives and contractual frameworks Identify and drive automation opportunities to reduce manual intervention in payment and dispute processes Conduct periodic pricing benchmarking and market analysis to ensure Amazon's partner economics remain competitive Manage escalations related to partner payments and disputes, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder alignment Define and track KPIs for the team, establishing clear goals, performance standards, and development plans for direct reports A day in the life Your day starts with metrics review and the team's priorities. Your focus centers on strategic decisions that shape partner economics across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL. You lead cross‑functional negotiations with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to align pricing models with business objectives. You assess incentive program ROI, recommending adjustments to optimize cost efficiency and partner performance. You review payment accuracy dashboards, identifying systemic gaps and designing scalable mechanisms to address them. Between meetings, you coach your team on stakeholder influence and data‑driven storytelling. Every day balances strategic thinking, cross‑functional alignment, and talent development to drive sustainable partner economics at scale. About the team The Pricing & Payments team is part of Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience organization, supporting the EDSP, AMXL, and AMPL programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission is to ensure Amazon's logistics partners operate under competitive, transparent, and accurate pricing and payment frameworks, while driving performance through well‑designed incentive programs and efficient dispute resolution. We build scalable pricing models, payment governance mechanisms, and incentive strategies that balance cost efficiency with partner sustainability. The team sits within a broader strategic structure that also covers Compliance & Communications, Network Health & Performance, and VAS & DA Experience — working cross‑functionally to support Amazon's Last Mile growth in Brazil. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, operations, logistics, supply chain or engineering Speak, write, and read fluent in English Experience managing and developing high‑performance teams Experience conducting sophisticated and creative analysis of complex data and translating results into actionable deliverables, messages, and presentations Experience working with cross‑functional teams across business development, marketing, operations, product development, legal, etc. Experience implementing scalable compliance solutions (technology, procedures, processes, etc.) in a regulated environment Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English Experience in deal management and pricing strategy, or financial consulting Preferred Qualifications MBA, or Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field Experience using SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques Experience in logistics Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing efforts, transportation and logistics, or fulfillment and distribution centers Experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis, or experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field Experience designing incentive programs or performance‑based compensation structures Experience building payment reconciliation or dispute management mechanisms at scale Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Fleet Services Manager
description: Fleet Services Manager Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. The Position The Fleet Service Manager will oversee the efficient and effective operation of the Tournament fleet and any ancillary event. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing all aspects of fleet services and operations, working close to the other Transport workstreams providing a reliable, on-time and outstanding service for the established FIFA Client Groups, such as PMAs, Referees, VVIP, FIFA Delegates, FIFA Workforce and Arrivals and Departures. The Fleet Services and Operations Manager will play a crucial role in optimizing fleet performance, developing and ensuring compliance of Service Level Agreements, Policies and Procedures, Operational Plan and Reports. This role reports to the Senior Transport Manager. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary liaison between the Transport FA and FIFA/LFS departments for all fleet-related planning and operational matters for FWWC2027 and any ancillary event. Act as the primary operational interface between FIFA Transport and the VIK vehicle provider (Hyundai/Kia), ensuring full alignment on vehicle specifications, delivery timelines, service levels, and operational needs. Coordinate the reception, inspection, and acceptance of VIK vehicles, ensuring all units meet quality and operational readiness criteria before deployment. Manage the return, decommissioning, and handback process of VIK vehicles post-tournament, including damage reporting, documentation, and reconciliation with the provider. Act as the primary operational interface with Vehicle and drivers’ suppliers ensuring service has been delivered as per contract. Monitor Fleet services performance against agreed KPIs, escalating issues and implementing corrective actions when service levels are not met. Manage all ancillary contracts and operational processes related to the fleet, including vehicle washing and cleaning, refueling services, toll management, and the handling of traffic fines. Develop the fleet depot Concept of Operations (including the fleet design) and ensure its implementation across all Host Cities. Coordinate with all Host Cities depot locations, space, utilities, and facility requirements to confirm requirements are fully met. Overall accountability for appropriate staffing levels and quality employees relating to all Fleet Operations. Act as the central coordinator for the development of Fleet Policies & Procedures, reports, presentations and Guidelines. Manage day-to-day operations pre and during event and subordinate staff including supervisors, coordinators, dispatchers, depot planners, administrative assistants and drivers. Do the entire setup of the Fleet Tournament Management System (TMM). Ensures all fleet staff are properly trained by developing and maintaining training materials and coordinating the delivery of FIFA-required modules (e.g TMM, fleet management system), operational workshops and briefings, safety guidelines, and role-specific instructions. The manager maintains consistent training standards across all Host Cities. Its also responsible, in coordination with the fleet service providers, for developing and delivering the full training program for all drivers and fleet operational team, including designing training content, defining formats (classroom, online, practical sessions), and establishing clear timelines and schedules. This includes planning how and when training will be delivered across all Host Cities, determining training duration and required number of days, organizing group sessions to cover the entire driver workforce, and ensuring consistent standards and materials. During tournament ensure all job requests are correctly entered, validated, and assigned with the appropriate vehicle and driver. Oversee dispatching procedures, monitor vehicles while in operation, and ensure real-time coordination with Host Cities for seamless service delivery. Particular attention should be given to VVIP vehicles and all arrival and departure transfers, ensuring precise planning, communication, and execution in alignment with other Host City transport teams. Provide regular reporting to the Transport Senior Manager, FIFA counterparts, and other key stakeholders on coordination progress, issues, and decisions. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with other event areas (Security, FIFA Travel, Guest Operations, TSV, etc.) to ensure coherent and efficient engagement with fleet service matters. Your Profile Bachelor’s Degree in Transport/Logistics/Civil Engineering/Project management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset. Minimum of six (6) years of event transport and fleet services experience in international major events in at least three (3) world-class sport/football events. E.g. FIFA World Cup/Olympic Games. Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management.
